title: [Bug] v2.0.73 - Severe text rendering loss on Windows
body:
## Environment
- Claude Code version: 2.0.73
- OS: Windows

## Symptoms
1. Text content randomly truncated
2. List numbering skips (jumps to "4.")
3. Formatted blocks show partial content
4. Large blank spaces

## Steps
1. Run custom skill with markdown
2. Response is severely truncated
author: sputnicyoji
